info.headline: Media Production - 10/21 - Brooklyn Navy Yard (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-20-2026 at 05:00 PM.
A media production with a simulated explosion and a 20-foot fireball effect is scheduled to take place from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM on 10/21 in the area of Washington Avenue and Flushing Avenue in Brooklyn. FDNY will be on site.
To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2hRNgJl.
